description: This file defines the Operator class used to represent mathematical operators within a calculator or expression evaluator. It includes details about operator symbols, precedence, associativity, operand count, and methods to access these properties. The class also manages collections of operators by their operand count and enforces rules such as unique symbols and supported associativity.

classes.name: Operator
classes.description: Represents a mathematical operator with properties such as symbol, precedence, associativity, and operand count. Provides methods for accessing these properties and ensures operators are uniquely identified and correctly categorized.

classes.name: Operator.Associativity
classes.description: Enum defining the associativity types of operators: LEFT, RIGHT, and NONE.

methods.name: getSymbol
methods.description: Returns the symbol representing the operator.

methods.name: getOperandCount
methods.description: Returns the number of operands the operator takes.

methods.name: getAssociativity
methods.description: Returns the associativity type of the operator (LEFT or RIGHT).

methods.name: getPrecedence
methods.description: Returns the precedence level of the operator.
